s: In the picture, the lamp is hanging 　　　 the table.【100　年北北基】
e: 在圖片中，燈懸掛在桌子的上方，因為沒有接觸到物體表面，所以選(Ｄ)　above（在…上方）。

s: You’re really 　　　 to go swimming in the lake on a cold winter day.  Don’t you feel cold?【100　年北北基】
e: 由第二句的反問可以推知說話者並不贊同在寒冷的冬天游泳，所以應選形容詞瘋狂的（crazy）。

s: Every night at 7:　00, the garbage truck appears on the streets to 　　　 the garbage that people take out of their houses.【100　年北北基】
e: 句意為「每天晚上七點的時候，垃圾車會出現在街頭收集人們從家裡拿出來的垃圾。」收集垃圾的動詞片語為　collect the garbage。

s: There is no 　　　 near the theater, so let’s take the bus there.【100　年北北基】
e: 因為後半句建議搭乘大眾運輸工具去（take the bus there），所以推知劇院附近沒有停車場（parking space）。

s: I want to go camping in the mountains this afternoon, but a typhoon is coming.  I’m not sure 　　　 the road to the mountains will be closed.【100　年北北基】
e: 句意為「我不確定往山上的路是否會被封閉起來。」要表達不確定語意的間接問句時，要用　whether（...or not）或　if（是否）當連接詞，其前面常有　not know、not sure　等提示字。

s: All the dresses are pretty, but I think 　　　 black one is the best for the party tomorrow.【100　年北北基】
e: 句意為「所有的洋裝都很漂亮，但是我認為那件黑色的最適合明天的宴會」。不定代名詞　one　前面要有定冠詞　the。

s: Joseph was painting the wall when the phone rang.  He quickly 　　　 his brush and ran to answer it.【100　年北北基】
e: 因為前句說明正在粉刷牆壁（was painting the wall），所以推知須先放下（put down）刷子，才能去接聽電話。

s: The boss called from the airport an hour 　　　, so I guess he will arrive at the office soon.【100　年北北基】
e: 由動詞　called　可知前半句為過去式，須搭配過去式的時間副詞，又因為有時間　an hour，故應配合使用片語「時間＋ago」來表示「…時間以前」。

s: I can’t find my history book, 　　　 I know it’s somewhere in the living room.【100　年北北基】
e: 句意為「我找不到我的歷史課本，可是我知道它在客廳中的某個地方」。因為前後句語意有轉折，所以要用連接詞　but。

s: The most convenient way to get around this small town is 　　　 a bike.【100　年北北基】
e: 句意為「遊覽這個小鎮最便利的方式就是騎腳踏車。」本句的不定詞是放在　be　動詞之後，當主詞補語的功能。

s: The pie at your party 　　　 good.  Where did you buy it?【100　年北北基】
e: 句意為「你派對上的派嘗起來很不錯。」因為動詞後面接形容詞　good，故推知應選連綴動詞　taste。

s: This kind of animal is 　　　 seen in everyday life because it lives 4,000m under the sea and is hard to find.【100　年北北基】
e: 因為後句說明這種動物居住在海底　4,000　公尺處，很難發現，所以推知該動物很少被看到，故選(Ｃ)　seldom。

s: the dog that bites people yours?  You should keep it home.【100　年北北基】
e: 句中的　that bites people　為關係子句，主要子句為　Is the dog yours?整句句意為「這隻咬人的狗是你的嗎？」，主詞為「這隻狗」，後接主詞補語「你的嗎」，故應選單數　be　動詞　is。

s: Alice doesn’t take medicine when she has a cold.  She believes the body is able to 　　　 the cold by itself.【100　年北北基】
e: 因為前句說明「Alice　感冒時不吃藥」，所以推知句意是「她相信身體自己能夠對抗感冒」，與感冒（cold）搭配的動詞有　catch（感染）或　fight（對抗），由句意可知應選用後者。

s: I think 　　　 is more fun to go to the movies with my friends than with my family.【100　年北北基】
e: 此句中，名詞子句的連接詞　that　因為當受詞所以被省略，it　是名詞子句中真主詞（不定詞　to go）的虛主詞。

s:
Jason: Dear, dinner’s almost 　　　. Are you hungry?
Joyce: Yes! I can’t wait to eat!【100　年北北基】
e: 由最後一句　can’t wait to eat，可推知晚餐是　almost ready（快準備好的）。

s:
Henry: Don’t you think fishing is 　　　? You just sit by the water and wait all day long.
Grace: No, I enjoy the quiet time of fishing.【100　年北北基】
e: 因為在　Henry　說的第二句話中有暗示的提示詞　just sit... and wait...，所以推知他認為釣魚是個　boring（無聊的）活動。

s:
Mom: Oh, no! Your sister forgot her sports shoes. When 　　　 she have PE class? Can you take the shoes to her school?
Peter: It’s in the afternoon. Don’t worry. I’ll bring them to her.【100　年北北基】
e: 因為　Peter　以現在簡單式　It’s... 回答，所以也應該使用現在簡單式的助動詞（does）來詢問現在的事實狀態。

s:
Jane: Ned hasn’t talked to me for two days because I laughed at his hair color. What should I do?
Lois: You should go and tell him that you’re sorry. He’s nice, and I’m sure he’ll give you another 　　　.【100　年北北基】
e: 因為　Jane　做錯事，所以推知應該是要去道歉並獲得再一次的　chance（機會）。

s:
Nana: Did you mail the cards to your teachers?
Annie: No, I want to check them again. I 　　　 them after dinner.【100　年北北基】
e: 因為　Annie　回答說　No，所以得知她尚未寄出卡片，推知她將會在晚餐後寄出，故應選用未來式。

p:
Monica　(１)　 the thin old man who lives next to her must be very poor and lonely. She often saw him wearing old clothes and sitting in the park by himself.
　　Last Christmas, when Monica was jogging in the park, the old man came up to her with a large bag on his shoulder. Monica guessed the old man 　(２)　 her for some money or help. But she was surprised to find many children following him. The old man took out a box from his bag and said to her with a big smile,“Merry Christmas! I bought presents for everybody. This one is for you.” At that moment, Monica understood her mistake and changed her idea about the old man. Since then, she 　(３)　 not to judge people by how they look. She now knows how people look is not the same as what they really are.
【100　年北北基】
　judge　判斷
e: 因為在第二段裡提到　Monica　對老人發禮物的這件事感到驚訝，可知與她之前對老人的看法有所出入，因此答案選(Ａ)　used to think（過去認為）。

s: (１)What can we learn about the little secretary?
p:
Little Secretary
When I do my math homework,
David likes to watch me.
Sometimes when I don’t know what to do,
He will count out loud.
Though my brother only knows 1, 2, 3,
He still tries to help me.
When I do my English homework,
David likes to watch me.
Sometimes when I don’t know what to write,
He will spell out loud.
Though my brother only knows A, B, C,
He still tries to help me.
Now I see it is his love
That makes him do all these for me.
John N.
【100　年北北基】
o: He is a junior high school student.
He does not like to be with his brother.
He knows more about English than about math.
He cannot do his brother’s homework very well.
e: 第一段提到　Though my brother only knows 1, 2, 3，第二段提到　Though my brother only knows A, B, C，由此可知作者的弟弟英數程度還很初階，不會給作者的功課帶來任何幫助，因此答案選(Ｄ)。

s:
(１)Which idea is NOT implied in the reading?
　imply　隱喻；暗示
p:
One hot summer afternoon, a rabbit went down to a river to drink some water. He saw himself in the river when he was drinking.
　　“Look at my beautiful long ears!”the rabbit said to himself. “I’m so proud of them. But my legs! They’re short and make me look stupid.”
　　When the rabbit finished drinking, he raised his head and found a tiger was jumping on him. With his short legs, the rabbit began to run as fast as the wind. The tiger could not catch up with him.
　　“I’m so lucky,”said the rabbit happily when he stopped running. Five minutes later, the tiger appeared again. Just at the moment when the rabbit saw the tiger, the tiger caught him by his long ears. That was the end of the rabbit.
【100　年北北基】
o: Even things we do not like can be useful.
Ask others’ ideas before taking any action.
People often fail to understand what may be important.
e: 故事大意為「兔子喜歡自己美麗的長耳朵，不喜歡自己的短腿，但短腿先讓兔子逃離老虎的追殺，長耳朵卻讓老虎抓到了牠」。此寓言暗喻「美麗的東西不一定好，有時討厭的東西反而能幫助自己」。選項(Ａ)(Ｂ)(Ｄ)都表達了相似的概念。

The rabbit was finally killed in his sleep.
The tiger caught the rabbit’s tail in the end.
The rabbit was able to run away the first time.

s: (１)What can we learn about Proust from this reading?
p:
Marcel Proust(1871～1922) is one of the greatest French writers. He is famous for his great book À la Recherche du Temps Perdu, which means“remembering the past.”
　　In this book, Proust writes many stories of rich but unhappy people. These rich people think they should be well liked or loved. When they learn that they are not as popular as they think, they feel sad and try hard to be important in the eyes of others. That is why they always feel troubled and can never really enjoy their lives.
　　In contrast to the lives of those people in his book, the last fifteen years of Proust’s life shows one can still find joy in hard times. During those years, he was very sick and had to stay in bed most of the time. But in his sickroom he found most joy in writing À la Recherche du Temps Perdu and ended up being a great writer because of the book.
【100　年北北基】
o: He became poor and sick because of writing.
He got a lot of pleasure from writing in his later life.
He often wrote about how people get stronger in hard times.
He started writing À la Recherche du Temps Perdu when he was fifteen.
e: 由第三段第三句「he found most joy in writing...」可知選項(Ｂ)為正解，因為有　joy　的同義字為　pleasure。

s: (２)Which is said about the rich people in Proust’s book?
p:
Marcel Proust(1871～1922) is one of the greatest French writers. He is famous for his great book À la Recherche du Temps Perdu, which means“remembering the past.”
　　In this book, Proust writes many stories of rich but unhappy people. These rich people think they should be well liked or loved. When they learn that they are not as popular as they think, they feel sad and try hard to be important in the eyes of others. That is why they always feel troubled and can never really enjoy their lives.
　　In contrast to the lives of those people in his book, the last fifteen years of Proust’s life shows one can still find joy in hard times. During those years, he was very sick and had to stay in bed most of the time. But in his sickroom he found most joy in writing À la Recherche du Temps Perdu and ended up being a great writer because of the book.
【100　年北北基】
o: They try to forget their past.
They try to get what they do not have.
They are sick and stay in bed most of the time.
They are rich enough to have their stories written.
e: 文章中說明　rich people　認為自己應被喜歡或愛著，他們會努力得到別人的注目，選項(Ｂ)接近文意，故選(Ｂ)。

s: (３)What does In contrast to mean?
p:
Marcel Proust(1871～1922) is one of the greatest French writers. He is famous for his great book À la Recherche du Temps Perdu, which means“remembering the past.”
　　In this book, Proust writes many stories of rich but unhappy people. These rich people think they should be well liked or loved. When they learn that they are not as popular as they think, they feel sad and try hard to be important in the eyes of others. That is why they always feel troubled and can never really enjoy their lives.
　　In contrast to the lives of those people in his book, the last fifteen years of Proust’s life shows one can still find joy in hard times. During those years, he was very sick and had to stay in bed most of the time. But in his sickroom he found most joy in writing À la Recherche du Temps Perdu and ended up being a great writer because of the book.
【100　年北北基】
e: 因為第二段提到有錢人不快樂，而第三段提到　Proust　仍可以在困頓時找到喜樂，所以推知　in contrast to　的意思為「相反地」。
